name: go
description: Use when the user writes, reviews, debugs, or refactors Go code — a `.go` file, `go.mod`, a Go package or web service, "golang", a goroutine or interface design question, or an error-handling decision. Not for Cobra/Viper CLI wiring (use cobra-viper), cutting a release (use go-release), reviewing a design doc or spec (use go-spec-reviewer), a Wails desktop app (use wails), or cross-filesystem moves and untrusted path segments (use fileflow-pathologize). Current through Go 1.27.
